articles.title: Faith, Fear and Theft: CCTV Shows Barefoot Thief Hesitating Before Stealing Temple Donation Box
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A donation box was stolen from the ancient Mata Sheetla Devi Temple in Lucknow’s Cantonment Sadar area, with CCTV footage capturing the entire incident in striking detail. The theft came to light when the temple priest noticed the donation box missing on Wednesday morning.

body.html:
A donation box was stolen from the ancient Mata Sheetla Devi Temple in Lucknow’s Cantonment Sadar area, with CCTV footage capturing the entire incident in striking detail. The theft came to light when the temple priest noticed the donation box missing on Wednesday morning.

According to the CCTV footage, the accused, entered the temple barefoot. He first carefully removed items placed on top of the donation box, including a bowl of vermilion, a burning lamp—ensuring it did not get extinguished—a matchbox, and a red cloth. He was then seen holding the donation box for around 15 seconds, appearing hesitant and wiping sweat from his face.

Temple priest Pandit Pramod Kumar Pandey said the footage showed the thief in visible confusion. “He held the donation box for some time but could not gather the courage to lift it. He wiped his sweat, looked towards Hanumanji, and only then picked up the donation box,” the priest said. Before leaving, the accused turned back to take darshan and walked a few steps backwards, as if avoiding turning his back towards the deity.

The incident took place at the ancient Sheetla Mata Temple located on Nehru Road. A written complaint has been filed at the Cantt police station, and the CCTV footage has been handed over to the police.

Station in-charge Jasveer Kaur confirmed that a complaint has been registered and said efforts are underway to identify and trace the accused based on the CCTV footage.

articles.title: Girl Held Hostage at Knifepoint in Bijnor Garment Shop, Police Rescue Her Safely
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic hostage situation unfolded in Bijnor district of Uttar Pradesh on December 31, when a man held a girl at knifepoint inside a clothing shop in Najibabad market. Police acted swiftly and rescued the girl unharmed, arresting the accused.

body.html:
A dramatic hostage situation unfolded in Bijnor district of Uttar Pradesh on December 31, when a man held a girl at knifepoint inside a clothing shop in Najibabad market. Police acted swiftly and rescued the girl unharmed, arresting the accused.

The incident occurred around 7 pm near Krishna Talkies during a garment sale. Two minor girls were shopping at the store when a masked 24-year-old man suddenly entered, grabbed one of the girls by the neck, and threatened her with a knife. He allegedly demanded ₹1 lakh in cash and a motorcycle from the shop owner.

The tense standoff lasted for nearly 30 minutes, causing panic in the busy market. A large crowd gathered outside the shop, but no one intervened initially due to the accused’s threats. Police personnel on New Year’s Eve patrol reached the spot promptly, engaged the accused in conversation, and eventually overpowered him, seizing the knife and freeing the girl without any injury.

Both girls were later medically examined and found to be safe. CCTV footage from the area is being analysed as part of the investigation.

The accused has been identified as Ajit, also known as Ajeet Bal Govind, a resident of Surjanpur village in Barabanki district. During questioning, he claimed he wanted to go to jail due to personal troubles, though police said his exact motive remains unclear as he also made monetary demands. Further interrogation is underway to assess his mental state and circumstances leading to the incident.

articles.title: IRS Officer Arrested as Bribe Kingpin: CBI Busts ₹1.5 Crore GST Extortion Racket in Jhansi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: In a major corruption case in Jhansi, Central GST Deputy Commissioner and IRS officer Prabha Bhandari has been arrested by the CBI for allegedly masterminding a ₹1.5 crore bribery racket.

body.html:
In a major corruption case in Jhansi, Central GST Deputy Commissioner and IRS officer Prabha Bhandari has been arrested by the CBI for allegedly masterminding a ₹1.5 crore bribery racket. The arrest followed the CBI catching two GST superintendents red-handed while accepting a ₹70 lakh bribe.

The CBI trapped GST Superintendents Anil Tiwari and Ajay Kumar Sharma while they were receiving the first instalment of ₹70 lakh. During interrogation, both officers disclosed that the bribe was being collected at the direction of Deputy Commissioner Prabha Bhandari. They told investigators that the total deal was fixed at ₹1.5 crore.

In a recorded call arranged by the CBI, the superintendent informed Prabha Bhandari that ₹70 lakh had been received. She allegedly instructed him to convert the cash into gold and deliver it to her. At the time, Prabha Bhandari was in Delhi, where a CBI team later arrested her.

Simultaneously, the CBI conducted raids at her Jhansi flat, seizing cash, gold, silver, and property-related documents. Around ₹90 lakh in additional cash was recovered during searches. Prabha Bhandari’s husband is a serving Army Colonel.

The case is linked to a raid conducted on December 19 at Jai Durga Hardware in Jhokan Bagh, Jhansi, over alleged GST evasion amounting to ₹13 crore. It is alleged that GST officials demanded ₹1.5 crore to settle the case. Firm owner Raju Mangnani and lawyer Naresh Kumar Gupta were also arrested in connection with the bribery case.

Overall, cash worth about ₹1.6 crore, along with jewellery and documents, has been recovered so far. Prabha Bhandari was produced before a Ghaziabad court and later taken to Lucknow on remand. The other accused were produced before a Jhansi court and sent to Lucknow. Further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Gym Trainer Booked in Dehradun for Obscene Gestures and Messages to Women
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A serious case concerning women’s safety has emerged from the Clementtown police station area in Dehradun, where a gym trainer has been accused of inappropriate behaviour with female members.

body.html:
A serious case concerning women’s safety has emerged from the Clementtown police station area in Dehradun, where a gym trainer has been accused of inappropriate behaviour with female members. Police have registered a case and launched an investigation following complaints by several women.

The incident pertains to Fit & Fine Gym near Chandramani Chowk. According to the complainants, trainer Nadeem Ansari allegedly made obscene gestures, passed objectionable comments, and touched women inappropriately during exercise sessions. The women also alleged that he later sent them obscene messages.

The victims stated that despite earlier objections, the trainer’s behaviour did not change, prompting them to jointly approach the police. Acting on the complaint, Clementtown police registered a case under relevant sections of law.

Following the incident, tension prevailed in the area, with organisations including the Bajrang Dal demanding strict action and stating that such acts are an attack on the dignity and safety of women.

Dehradun SP City Pramod Kumar said the matter is being investigated thoroughly. Statements of other gym members and staff are being recorded, and further legal action will be taken based on the findings. Police have said strict action will follow if the allegation are proven.

articles.title: Wrong-Side Riding Caught on CCTV: Scooter Hits Gas Cylinder Auto in Mandla, Two Women Injured
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two young women were injured in a road accident involving a scooter and a cargo auto-rickshaw in Mandla district on Tuesday. The incident occurred in the Chaurasia Mohalla area of Bineka village under the Kotwali police station limits and was captured on a nearby CCTV camera.

body.html:
Two young women were injured in a road accident involving a scooter and a cargo auto-rickshaw in Mandla district on Tuesday. The incident occurred in the Chaurasia Mohalla area of Bineka village under the Kotwali police station limits and was captured on a nearby CCTV camera.

The accident took place on Tuesday morning, while the CCTV footage surfaced on Wednesday. The video shows a biker moving in the correct direction, while a scooter carrying two women was coming from the wrong side at high speed. While attempting to avoid the biker, the scooter lost balance and collided head-on with a cargo auto loaded with gas cylinders.

The impact was severe, leaving the scooter badly damaged and throwing both women onto the road. Locals and the driver of the gas-cylinder-laden vehicle immediately rushed to help and took the injured women to the district hospital.

After initial treatment, the condition of one of the women worsened, following which she was referred to Jabalpur Medical College. Police have initiated an investigation and are analysing the CCTV footage to ascertain the exact cause of the accident.

articles.title: Hathras Love Tragedy: Woman Dies After Marriage Refusal, Video Blames Boyfriend
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A young woman in Hathras allegedly died after her boyfriend refused to marry her. Before taking the extreme step, the woman recorded a video blaming her boyfriend, Akash, and sent it to her aunt. The incident occurred in Awas Vikas Colony under the Sadar Kotwali area.

body.html:
A young woman in Hathras allegedly died after her boyfriend refused to marry her. Before taking the extreme step, the woman recorded a video blaming her boyfriend, Akash, and sent it to her aunt.

The incident occurred in Awas Vikas Colony under the Sadar Kotwali area. The deceased has been identified as Kamini Sharma, a resident of the colony. On Monday afternoon, Kamini consumed poison and was rushed to hospital by her family, where doctors declared her dead.

The video surfaced on Tuesday, after her funeral. In the video, Kamini is heard saying that she was being forced by Akash to take her life and that she had no desire to commit suicide. She apologised to her mother, calling her “the best mother in the world,” and accused Akash and his family of playing with her life.

Kamini’s mother, Rashmi Sharma, has lodged a complaint at the Sadar Kotwali police station. City Superintendent of Police Yogendra Krishna Narayan confirmed that the complaint has been received and the matter is under investigation.

articles.title: Burqa Dance Sparks Outrage in Amroha School Carnival, Video Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A controversy has erupted after a video surfaced showing students of Mesco Public School in Amroha dancing on stage while wearing burqas and hijabs during a school carnival.

body.html:
A controversy has erupted after a video surfaced showing students of Mesco Public School in Amroha dancing on stage while wearing burqas and hijabs during a school carnival. The incident took place on December 29 during a carnival festival held at the school, located in the Naugawan Sadat police station area.

The viral video shows three boys dressed in burqas entering the stage and dancing to the song “FA9LA” from the film Dhurandhar. Soon after, several other boys climbed onto the stage and joined the performance, as students in the audience clapped and cheered.

Reacting strongly, Advocate and Muslim Committee leader Mansoor Ahmed termed the act “against Islamic values” and demanded strict action, including revocation of the school’s recognition.

Meanwhile, the school principal issued a written apology, calling the incident “unfortunate and unintentional.” She clarified that the act was not part of the official programme and was allegedly performed to entertain the audience. The school stated that such conduct does not reflect its values, discipline, or culture, and condemned the act, while apologising if sentiments were hurt.

Police have taken note of the viral video. Amroha Police, in a post on X, said the Naugawan Sadat station in-charge has been directed to take appropriate action in the matter.

articles.title: CCTV Captures Fatal Moment: NRI Killed as Holstered Gun Goes Off at Home in Punjab
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: An NRI man died after a loaded pistol holstered at his waist accidentally went off while he was getting up from a sofa in Dhani Sucha Singh village of Punjab’s Firozepur district, police said.

body.html:
An NRI man died after a loaded pistol holstered at his waist accidentally went off while he was getting up from a sofa in Dhani Sucha Singh village of Punjab’s Firozepur district, police said.

The incident occurred on Monday when Harpinder Singh alias Sonu was sitting on a sofa with a relative. As he stood up, the pistol discharged, and the bullet hit him in the stomach. The entire incident was captured on the house’s CCTV cameras.

Family members rushed to his help after hearing the gunshot and took him to a government hospital. Doctors referred him to another hospital in Bathinda, but he died on the way.

Harpinder’s body was sent for postmortem. Sadar police station SHO Ravinder Sharma recorded the statement of his father, Darshan Singh, and initiated proceedings under Section 194 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS).

Harpinder had recently returned from abroad, was married, and is survived by his wife and a two-year-old daughter. His funeral was held on Tuesday, with villagers and Aam Aadmi Party leaders attending.
